hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Salem, Oregon as headquarters; Open Dental's employment page says it is located in Salem, Oregon.

public_docs.notes: The documentation page links a public Quick Manual; the company also maintains a public manual with many documentation pages.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile says Open Dental has not raised funding, so there was no round in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

founded_year.notes: Both LinkedIn and the company's employment page state the company was founded in 2003.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn reports that Open Dental has not raised funding; the Crunchbase profile does not show an outside funding round. No round date or amount therefore applies.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-08-13, within the six-month window, Open Dental announced stable version 26.1 and the release of ODTouch 25 with new features.

pricing_page.notes: The company publishes fees and subscription pricing for its software and services.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 201–500 employees; the company blog separately said it had over 300 employees in 2022.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists current openings but no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive role.

model_provider.notes: The public AI image-analysis information names integrations with BetterDiagnostics and Pearl but does not identify the AI model or underlying model provider.

named_customers.notes: Both are explicitly named testimonial authors/customers on the testimonials page; the page attributes testimonials to Capterra or G2.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists current openings, including engineering positions, but none of the titles is AI, ML, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

compliance_certs.notes: The company has a HIPAA page discussing its safeguards and a GDPR page. These are publicly named compliance topics; the pages do not establish SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS certifications.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The careers and documentation pages reviewed do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system used by Open Dental. Third-party vendors advertise connectors to products such as HubSpot and Salesforce, but this does not establish Open Dental's own use.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes it as practice-management software for dental offices and practices of any size.
product_one_liner.value: Open Dental provides comprehensive, customizable dental practice-management software for dental offices and practices of any size.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I found no dated announcement or profile establishing a C-level or VP-level join/departure in the window. The available leadership/history information is not sufficient to verify a negative.
